name: tr_steph
caption:
IF STEPH HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐟 Feebas: so ragged that no one catches it. 6 teams passed, we took him at #7
🥷 Greninja: it appears and vanishes like a ninja. The Baby-Faced Assassin before he was Chef Curry
🎯 Inteleon: its ability is Sniper, and it shoots from its fingertips. First player ever to 4,000 threes
✨ Arceus: legend says it shaped the world. 2 MVPs, including the first unanimous one
👑 Kingambit: it commands a massive army. 4 rings, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2022
🔥 Cinderace: it gets pumped up when cheered on. 38 years old, 30.6 points a night in his first 9 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Stephen Curry had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF STEPH HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Feebas. It looks so ragged that no one bothers to catch it. Six teams passed on Steph. We took him seventh.
beats.dlg: NO ONE BOTHERS CATCHING IT|6 PASSED. WE TOOK HIM #7!

beats.vo: Greninja. It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. They called him the Baby-Faced Assassin long before Chef Curry.
Inteleon. Its ability is literally called Sniper, and it shoots water from its fingertips. The first player ever to four thousand career threes.
beats.dlg: ITS ABILITY IS SNIPER.|FIRST EVER TO 4,000 THREES

beats.vo: Arceus. Legend says it shaped the whole world. Two MVPs, and the first unanimous one ever.
beats.dlg: IT SHAPED THE WORLD.|2 MVPS, FIRST UNANIMOUS!

beats.vo: Kingambit. It commands a massive army. Four rings with us: twenty fifteen, seventeen, eighteen, and twenty twenty-two.
And the ace. Cinderace. It gets pumped up when the crowd cheers it on. Thirty-eight years old, and still thirty point six a night in his first nine games.
beats.dlg: PUMPED UP WHEN CHEERED ON.|AGE 38, 30.6 A NIGHT!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Curry: 2009 draft, 7th overall pick (#7) by Golden State; Minnesota took two other point guards at 5 and 6 (6 teams passed on him); referred to as the Baby-Faced Assassin since a young age and Chef Curry in the NBA; March 13, 2025: first player in NBA history to reach 4,000 career three-pointers; 2x MVP (2015, 2016), first ever unanimous MVP; 4x NBA champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022); born March 14, 1988 (age 38)
